public_rationale: The cited study supports the narrower observation that pragmatic interpretation challenged contemporary language models. Its strongest prompted model also reached what the researchers called near-human performance. Neither result establishes whether the systems lacked cognitive representations or commonsense knowledge. Scoring the full statement would require silently equating the absence of explicit machinery with the absence of those resources. The evidence therefore leaves the full claim unresolved.
limitations: The finding does not deny the demonstrated difficulty.
A near-human result on one binary task does not establish reliable pragmatic understanding generally.
This observation is assessed against contemporary systems, not later models.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Systems established to lack those resources reliably interpret a suitably broad range of pragmatic implications without substantial difficulty.
